up: List the compounds reported in the document with chembl_id 'CHEMBL4651341'. Return the following columns for each compound: the compound's chembl_id (ChEMBL ID), pref_name (Preferred Name), max_phase (Max Phase), molecule_type (Molecule Type), and canonical_smiles (SMILES). Sort the results by the compound's ChEMBL ID.
sql:
SELECT
  md.chembl_id AS "ChEMBL ID",
  md.pref_name AS "Preferred Name",
  md.max_phase AS "Max Phase",
  md.molecule_type AS "Molecule Type",
  cs.canonical_smiles AS "SMILES"
FROM docs d
JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4651341'
ORDER BY md.chembl_id;
